weltAal.text1: A multiplayer puzzle game for public spaces using custom foot pedal controllers.
weltAal.text2: Cooperative multiplayer game with resource management and enemy mechanics, developed in Godot Engine 4.4 using GDScript. The focus was on the intuitive use of non-traditional input devices. Implemented a cooperative level system with multiple difficulty levels and enemy types, complemented by visual and acoustic design following the '8 Kinds of Fun' framework.

collectivity.text1: A Serious Game that makes ten Media Informatics Meet-Ups experienceable through interactive gameplay.
collectivity.text2: Level-based Serious Game, developed with Unity and C#, where each level playfully represents a Meet-Up theme. The central task was the translation of abstract content into understandable game mechanics. This was supported by a playtesting and usability framework for clear learning and game flows.

defeatTheBeast.text1: A browser-based action game with a dynamic difficulty system, regenerating boss, and permanent time pressure.
defeatTheBeast.text2: The challenge lay in balancing time pressure, resource management, and enemy behavior. Complemented by a progression and upgrade system with exploration and multiple difficulty levels, implemented in Unity (LTS 2022.3.14) with C#.

pitipsDe.text1: A research platform for networking informal caregivers with scientific projects.
pitipsDe.text2: Web platform with map, search, and filter functions for quick project finding. The focus was on the understandable presentation of complex research content. Implemented a user-centered navigation and onboarding system for a low entry barrier.

escooty.text1: A web application for visualizing public mobility data for traffic planning.
escooty.text2: Multi-layer map system for mobility and infrastructure data, developed with Vue.js, Leaflet, and Turf.js. The central challenge was the integration and visualization of heterogeneous geodata. Complemented by interactive planning tools for location and coverage analysis.

bachelorThesisWebApp.text1: A web application for presenting citizen participation projects.
bachelorThesisWebApp.text2: Accessible information system following Human-Centered Design principles with Vue.js. The focus was on the clear structuring of complex project information as well as the implementation of accessibility features for broad usability.

masterThesisGame.title: Teaching basic programming concepts using VR
masterThesisGame.text1: A hybrid learning system consisting of VR and web-based modules for teaching programming concepts.
masterThesisGame.text2: Combination of web-based learning modules and immersive VR training with Unity. The central challenge was the transfer of abstract programming logic into interactive VR experiences. Developed a didactically combined learning system of VR nuggets and web modules, whose learning success was evaluated.

opticalIllusionsVR.title: Optical Illusions in VR
opticalIllusionsVR.text1: A VR application that makes optical illusions and Impossible Spaces experienceable through movement.
opticalIllusionsVR.text2: The focus was on the targeted use of perceptual illusions for spatial distortion as well as movement-based puzzle mechanics.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.complianceText: This website strives to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA, as required by EU Directive 2016/2102 and the German Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG).
accessibilityStatement.standardsText: This website has been developed to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards. We have implemented various measures to ensure accessibility for all users.
accessibilityStatement.measure1: Semantic HTML for better screen reader compatibility
accessibilityStatement.measure2: Full keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
accessibilityStatement.measure3: ARIA labels and roles for assistive technologies
accessibilityStatement.measure4: Adequate color contrast for better readability
accessibilityStatement.measure5: Dynamic language attributes for multilingual support
accessibilityStatement.feedbackText: We are committed to continuously improving the accessibility of this website. If you encounter barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us.
